title: Task/youtube import bug fixes
body:
## Description
<!-- Provide a brief description of the changes in this PR -->
- Keep toasts visible until the user actually keeps the tab open for 3 seconds. Otherwise keep the timer.
- Improve youtube video error messages when no transcript is found and unknown exception cases.
- Do a data source limit check before submitting a guru update. It checks website/youtube counts and pdf sizes. It does not do this check on selfhosted.
- Check the data source limit for admins as well.
- Fix Pdf operation negation on frontend. Its previous version was removing all Pdf file updates if any one of them is added then deleted (negated).
- Fix "pending changes" not disappearing when a data source is added/deleted
- Allow the same Pdf file to be uploaded consecutively. Added a uniqueness check for this. The old version disallowed uploading a Pdf, deleting it, and re-uploading it. Users had to upload a different file to clear the state.

## Type of Change
<!-- Please check the one that applies to this PR using "x". -->
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [x] Improvement (non-breaking change which improves existing functionality)
- [x] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Other (please describe):

## How Has This Been Tested?
<!-- Please describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes. -->
- Manually tested the toast visibility
- Tried to index videos that do not have any transcripts and checked their error message in the UI.
- Raised a random exception during video extraction and checked its error message in the UI.
- Added/deleted all types of data sources in a single payload and checked if it caught data source limits in the end result payload. Then, did the same after a successful submission to see if it kept working correctly with subsequent submissions.
- Set the website limit to 1 on selfhosted and indexed more than 1 website.
- Set the website limit to 1 on cloud on an admin user and could not index more than 1 website.
